description: Long, low-density casual chat. A little durable info buried in chatter; most turns are not memory-worthy. Tests that a Broad profile does not over-mine casual talk.

conversation.content: Ugh, rough week. Rained the whole time and I barely left the flat.
That sounds draining. Did you get any downtime at least?
A bit. Started learning bass guitar actually, been wanting to for years. Only know one scale so far.
Nice, bass is a great choice. How's it feeling?
Fun but my fingers hurt. Anyway I'm allergic to shellfish so we skipped the seafood place my sister suggested.
Good call avoiding that. Where did you end up?
Just made pasta at home. Watched three episodes of some detective show, forgot the name already.
Cozy. Sometimes that's exactly what a rainy week needs.
Yeah. Oh, my sister Mara is visiting next month, she lives in Lisbon now.
That's something to look forward to.

traps.note: A rainy week indoors is not a mental-health pattern.
A forgotten show name is not a durable preference.
